test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

P. You can use proper lighting, reduce screen glare, and take more breaks.

Q. However, one of the easiest habits to build is to follow the "20-20-20 rule".

R. There are lots of ways you can protect your eyes during the day.

S. Every 20 minutes of time spent staring at a screen, look away at an option that is at least 20 feet away for 20 seconds.
solution:
The correct answer is "RPQS"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let's look at the correct sequence of the passage. 
 
• Statement R is the opening sentence of the passage which says that there are numerous methods to safeguard your eyes during the day.
 
• Statement P is the second sentence of the passage which explains that you can improve your productivity by using appropriate lighting, reducing computer glare, and taking more pauses.
 
• Statement Q is the third sentence of the passage which explains that however, following the "20-20-20 rule" is one of the simplest routines to develop.
 
• Statement S is the last sentence of the passage which shows that after 20 minutes of staring at a screen, take a 20-second break and gaze away at a choice at least 20 feet away.

Hence, the correct sequence is R, P, Q, S

The correct answer is option 3.

The correct passage is: ***R**. There are lots of ways you can protect your eyes during the day. **P**. You can use proper lighting, reduce screen glare, and take more breaks. **Q**. However, one of the easiest habits to build is to follow the "20-20-20 rule". **S**. Every 20 minutes of time spent staring at a screen, look away at an option that is at least 20 feet away for 20 seconds.*
